name: eval_temperatures_bench
description: A benchmark for measuring how model outputs and answer quality change with different sampling temperatures. It evaluates variance in correctness, calibration, and response diversity as temperature is varied, allowing comparison of robustness and sensitivity across language models. Useful for understanding trade-offs between creativity and reliability at different decoding settings.
reputation: Niche research dataset used for temperature-sensitivity analyses; limited but growing adoption among model-evaluation researchers.
